meta.name: prisma-postgres
meta.description: Prisma Postgres setup and operations guidance across Console, create-db CLI, Management API, and Management API SDK. Use when creating Prisma Postgres databases, working in Prisma Console, provisioning with create-db/create-pg/create-postgres, or integrating programmatic provisioning with service tokens or OAuth.

copy.tagline: 快速创建和管理云端数据库，通过命令行或接口完成配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在云端创建和管理 Postgres 数据库，并想用命令行或接口自动化完成。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage cloud Postgres databases, configure via CLI or API.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision and manage PostgreSQL databases in the cloud via CLI or API.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按优先级分四类给出 Prisma Postgres 的操作指引:console 建库、用 create-db 临时库、用管理 API/SDK 做程序化开通、把本地项目连到已有库。会给出命令示例、鉴权方式和连接串处理。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 Prisma Postgres 数据库、在 Prisma Console 里操作、或用 create-db 等命令开通临时数据库时触发;涉及服务令牌/OAuth 的程序化开通也会接管。

say.text: 用 create-db 开一个临时 PostgreSQL 数据库。
帮我把本地项目连到已存在的 Prisma Postgres 数据库。

howto.what_en: Claude provides step-by-step guidance for Prisma Postgres across Console, create-db CLI, Management API and SDK. It covers provisioning temporary databases, linking local projects, API authentication, and printing connection strings/regions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when creating Prisma Postgres databases, working in Prisma Console, provisioning via create-db/create-pg/create-postgres, or using Management API with service tokens or OAuth.

say_en.text: Create a temporary PostgreSQL database with create-db.
say_en.note: Returns the npx command and auto-delete behavior.

say_en.text: Link my local project to an existing Prisma Postgres database.
say_en.note: Walks through prisma postgres link and .env update.

say_en.text: Provision a database using the Management API with a service token.
say_en.note: Shows endpoint, auth, and typed SDK routes.
